facts.fact: Inside Privacy (Covington) describes POPIA as South Africa's data protection framework and states that its breach-notification and security-safeguard obligations currently bind responsible parties and operators.

The Information Regulator introduced an online eServices Portal as the official platform for POPIA security-compromise notifications; the document reports no sanction or decision, and says Form SCN1 for manual reporting was first released in 2023.

The Information Regulator is stated to have announced on 7 April 2025 a requirement that breaches be reported through its eServices Portal, and receives breach notifications under POPIA, so it is an existing body acting.
